The world's most expensive tea is **Da Hong Pao** (Big Red Robe), an oolong tea from the Wuyi Mountains in **China**'s Fujian Province, costing over ₹9 crore (~$1 million+) per kilogram.

According to the **Forbes 2025 World's Billionaires list** (published April 2025), the richest billionaire from China is **Zhang Yiming**, founder of ByteDance (parent company of TikTok). He surpassed Zhong Shanshan, who had been China's richest person for four consecutive years, with an estimated net worth of approximately **$67 billion** at the time of the April 2025 ranking.
